name: Finance Fuel
format: One money right, trap or scam explained in 30-48 s, faceless: real logos (RBI, UPI, banks), real app screens, big ₹ numbers and a source card on screen. Hook in the first 4-6 words: a ₹ number the viewer gets or loses, a scam alert, a mistake warning, or a two-person money comparison. Ends with 'Save karo' + one question. Education only, never advice

voice.style: a confident, friendly young Indian money explainer talking to a friend who is just starting to earn; clear with numbers, a little surprised at the reveal, never preachy; speak slightly slower than a normal fast reel, with clear pauses between sentences

visuals.look: photorealistic premium studio render on deep black-green, money and banking objects, soft green and gold light
visuals.cast: no characters: real objects (cards, phones, coins, notes, documents), numbers, charts, UI, flows; hands only

rules: every number is real and current, with its source (RBI, SEBI, NPCI, Income Tax Dept, AMFI, the bank's own page) in sources.json; no guessed rates
tax and rate figures name the year they apply to (e.g. FY 2026-27)
scam reels show how the scam works and how to stay safe, never a working method
the caption ends with 'Education only, not financial advice.'
education only (SEBI): never tell anyone to buy or sell a specific stock, fund, coin or policy; no 'best fund', price targets or return claims
SEBI Jan 2025 clarification: no stock or market prices from the last 3 months in any example, and no live market commentary
every rule names who set it and when on screen (e.g. 'RBI circular, 20 Sep 2019'); forecasts and proposals are labelled as such

pillars: Bank aapko paisa dega (series): RBI rules where the bank must pay YOU (failed UPI ₹100/day, property papers ₹5,000/day, card closure ₹500/day, CIBIL fix ₹100/day)
Scam alert: how a live scam works and the one thing to do (wrong-UPI refund, digital arrest, fake KYC, loan apps); source: RBI, NPCI, I4C, 1930
Galti mat karna: buying traps with the real maths (gold making charges and HUID, No Cost EMI, minimum due, old gold resale)
Paisa news samjho: this week's RBI / NPCI / EPFO / tax change in 30 s, what changes for you (verified, 2+ sources, proposals labelled)
Save karo lists: official websites and rights every earner should know (UDGAM, Sanchar Saathi, AIS, ESIC benefits)
Concepts only: compounding, inflation, emergency fund, with exact arithmetic; never a product pick
